notes: Step counting: step 1 is the minifigure page (sword p8 with gold holder p97, shield p98); body = steps 2-9; leg A 10-15 (+16 attach); leg B 17-22 (+23); leg C 24-31 (+32); leg D 33-40 (+41); the 4x foot 42-45 (+46); head 47-54 (+55). Attach steps add no pieces. Four copies of the foot share the same step numbers.

Coordinates are my best reading of the booklet: model long axis runs along y, head toward low y, tail toward high y; body is 2 studs wide at x0-1. Legs hang at x=-2 (left) and x=3 (right); the lowest piece (foot base plates) is layer 0. Ball-jointed sub-assemblies (legs, feet, head) are approximate: the front feet are drawn further forward (y=-6..-5) than the ball socket they plug into, so the thigh arches p87/p88 (added in step 14/21) do not sit on feet added later in step 44; ball heights do not match exactly.

The model is one connected build: all sub-assemblies (legs, feet, head, tail) are joined to the body by ball/socket or clip joins listed in other_joins. Position-null items are connected too: minifigure parts p8, p97, p98 to each other and (assumption) to the body, sticker sheet p37 to the leg it is first applied to, trading card p89 to the sticker sheet (it is a loose extra, not part of the build).

Assumed mapping of manual part numbers to catalogue parts: 6043639=14418 (leg-bottom sockets), 6043656=14704 (leg-top/head sockets), 6039479=14417 (towball plates: 5 on body, 4 on feet), 4121932=4287b (rear legs), 4160403=42023 (body sides), 4140583=2540, 6018774=99781, 6004990=99780, 4249112=50950, 6034044=11477.
Leg A and B (front) are mirror copies; leg C and D (rear) are mirror copies. Leg A/C are the left side, B/D the right side. Foot copies are assigned in order to legs A, B, C, D.
Stickers (p37) are applied in several steps (legs, feet, head); recorded once at its first use (step 15) with no grid position. The trading card p89 is not used in the build (step 1, no position).

Pieces held by clips (p92 on p39's handle; p93/p94 in clips p71/p72) have rests_on [] because they are not clutched from below; the clip joins are in other_joins. Tail claw p1 and bar holder p2 are not on the stud grid (position null); p2 clips onto the side handle p38 at the rear of the body.
